scope: Independent source-level applicability of existing physical compact suppliers to the new regular Maass and continuous test. No rederivation or certification of gamma/Gaussian, orbital estimates, current author implementation or manuscript theorem.

declarations.name: carrierPushforward
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def carrierPushforward (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Measure (Gamma0OrbitSpace N) :=
  cellPushforward N (gamma0Carrier N)

declarations.name: QuotientL2
declarations.source_signature_or_definition: abbrev QuotientL2 (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] := Lp ℂ 2 (carrierPushforward N)

declarations.name: HeightSeed
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
structure HeightSeed where
  toFun : ℝ → ℂ
  continuous : Continuous toFun
  compact : HasCompactSupport toFun
  positive : tsupport toFun ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ)

declarations.name: SmoothHeightSeed
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
structure SmoothHeightSeed extends HeightSeed where
  cinfty : ContDiff ℝ ∞ toFun

declarations.name: scaledSeed
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def scaledSeed (m : ℤ) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (y : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.sqrt |(m : ℝ)| : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * ψ (|(m : ℝ)|*y)

declarations.name: orderRadial
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def orderRadial (m : ℤ) (ν : ℂ) (y : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  2*(Real.sqrt y : ℂ)*ComplexOrderKBridgeSourceOnly.complexOrderK ν (2*Real.pi*|(m : ℝ)|*y)

declarations.name: orderProbe
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def orderProbe (m : ℤ) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (ν : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ((y⁻¹)^2 : ℝ) • (star (ψ y)*orderRadial m ν y)

declarations.name: common_orderProbe
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem common_orderProbe (m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ 0) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (ν : ℂ) :
    orderProbe m (scaledSeed m ψ) ν = orderProbe 1 ψ ν

declarations.name: common_radialProbe
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem common_radialProbe (m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ 0) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    radialProbe m (scaledSeed m ψ) t = radialProbe 1 ψ t

spectrum

def spectrum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (V : Gamma0OrbitSpace N → ℂ) (a : Parameters N) (t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ u, star (V u)*quotientProfile a t u ∂carrierPushforward N

declarations.name: packet_L2
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem packet_L2 (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (one : Bool) (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℂ) (ind : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ S, ind b ≠ 0) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hpos : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) : MemLp (packet N one S w ind ψ) 2 (carrierPushforward N)

declarations.name: packet_spectrum
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem packet_spectrum (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (one : Bool) (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℂ) (ind : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hn : ∀ b ∈ S, ind b ≠ 0) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hpos : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (a : Parameters N) (t : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun u => star (packet N one S w ind ψ u)*quotientProfile a t u) (carrierPushforward N) ∧
    spectrum N (packet N one S w ind ψ) a t =
      radialProbe 1 ψ t*markedRow S w ind (fun n => nativeR a one n t)

declarations.name: originalFrame
declarations.source_signature_or_definition: def originalFrame (one : Bool) : SL(2,ℤ) := if one then cuspOneMatrix else 1

declarations.name: basis_packet_inner
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem basis_packet_inner (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i : actualCuspBasisIndex N (NeZero.pos N))
    (one : Bool) (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℂ) (ind : ℕ → ℤ) (hn : ∀ b ∈ S,ind b ≠ 0)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (hpos : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :
    inner ℂ ((packet_L2 N one S w ind hn ψ hψ hc hpos).toLp (packet N one S w ind ψ))
      (actualCuspHilbertBasis N (NeZero.pos N) i : QuotientL2 N) =
      orderProbe 1 ψ (basisOrder N (NeZero.pos N) i)*
        markedRow S w ind (basisR N (NeZero.pos N) i (originalFrame one))

declarations.name: packet_projection
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
private theorem packet_projection (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (one : Bool) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → ℂ) (ind : ℕ → ℤ) (hn : ∀ b ∈ S, ind b ≠ 0) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (hψ : Continuous ψ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (hp : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :
    (ℂ ∙ constantL2 N).starProjection ((packet_L2 N one S w ind hn ψ hψ hc hp).toLp
      (packet N one S w ind ψ)) = 0

declarations.name: marked_support
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem marked_support (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (one : Bool) (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℂ)
    (ind : ℕ → ℤ) (hn : ∀ b ∈ S,ind b ≠ 0) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (hψ : Continuous ψ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (hp : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :
    supportedInQuotientCompact N (packet N one S w ind ψ)

declarations.name: youngCuspEquiv
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def youngCuspEquiv (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Parameters N ≃ NativeCusps N :=
  Equiv.ofBijective _ ⟨parameter_injective N,parameter_surjective N⟩

declarations.name: nativeR
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def nativeR {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : Parameters N) (one : Bool) (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ ξ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (band N a.1.1), inverseWeight a.1 a.2 ξ*channelR ⟨a.1,ξ⟩ one n t

declarations.name: native_mode
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem native_mode {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : Parameters N) (one : Bool)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (t y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    sectionMode N (NeZero.pos N) one (cuspFamily N ((youngCuspEquiv N) a) (criticalPoint t)) n y hy =
      radial n t y*nativeR a one n t

declarations.name: nativeProduct
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def nativeProduct (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (X Y : Parameters N → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ a : Parameters N, star (X a)*Y a/(4*(Real.pi : ℂ))

declarations.name: nativeMass
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def nativeMass (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (X : Parameters N → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : Parameters N,‖X a‖^2/(4*Real.pi)

declarations.name: native_self_re
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
private theorem native_self_re (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (X : Parameters N → ℂ) :
    (nativeProduct N X X).re = nativeMass N X

declarations.name: marked_covariance
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem marked_covariance (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (t : ℝ) (left right : Bool)
    (S T : Finset ℕ) (c d : ℕ → ℂ) (p n : ℕ → ℤ) :
    classProduct N
      (fun i => markedRow S c p (fun a => channelR i left a t))
      (fun i => markedRow T d n (fun a => channelR i right a t)) =
    nativeProduct N
      (fun a => markedRow S c p (fun b => nativeR a left b t))
      (fun a => markedRow T d n (fun b => nativeR a right b t))

declarations.name: centeredSpace
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def centeredSpace (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : Submodule ℂ (QuotientL2 N) :=
  (Submodule.span ℂ (generators N)).topologicalClosure

declarations.name: nativeSynthesis_analysis_eq_projection
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem nativeSynthesis_analysis_eq_projection (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (v : QuotientL2 N) :
    nativeSynthesis N (fun a => analysis N a v) = (centeredSpace N).starProjection v

declarations.name: range_nativeSynthesis
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem range_nativeSynthesis (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    range (nativeSynthesis N) = (centeredSpace N : Set (QuotientL2 N))

declarations.name: continuous_projection_gram
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem continuous_projection_gram (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (v w : QuotientL2 N) :
    inner ℂ ((centeredSpace N).starProjection v) ((centeredSpace N).starProjection w) =
      (1/2 : ℂ)*∑ a : Parameters N,inner ℂ (analysis N a v) (analysis N a w)

declarations.name: centered_eq_physical_complement
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem centered_eq_physical_complement (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    centeredSpace N = (ℂ ∙ constantL2 N)ᗮ ⊓ (allFrameCuspSubspace N (NeZero.pos N))ᗮ

declarations.name: physical_split
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem physical_split (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (v : QuotientL2 N) :
    v=(ℂ ∙ constantL2 N).starProjection v+(allFrameCuspSubspace N (NeZero.pos N)).starProjection v+
      (centeredSpace N).starProjection v

declarations.name: spatial_orthogonal_gram
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem spatial_orthogonal_gram (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (v w : QuotientL2 N) :
    let C := ℂ ∙ constantL2 N
    let D := allFrameCuspSubspace N (NeZero.pos N)
    inner ℂ v w = inner ℂ (C.starProjection v) (C.starProjection w)+
      inner ℂ (D.starProjection v) (D.starProjection w)+
      (1/2 : ℂ)*∑ a : Parameters N,inner ℂ (analysis N a v) (analysis N a w)

declarations.name: integrated_native
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
private theorem integrated_native (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {X Y : Gamma0OrbitSpace N → ℂ}
    (hx : MemLp X 2 (carrierPushforward N)) (hy : MemLp Y 2 (carrierPushforward N))
    (cx : supportedInQuotientCompact N X) (cy : supportedInQuotientCompact N Y)
    (rx : (ℂ ∙ constantL2 N).starProjection (hx.toLp X)=0)
    (ry : (ℂ ∙ constantL2 N).starProjection (hy.toLp Y)=0) :
    let G := fun t => nativeProduct N (fun a => spectrum N X a t) (fun a => spectrum N Y a t)
    Integrable G ∧ inner ℂ (hy.toLp Y) (nativeSynthesis N (fun a => analysis N a (hx.toLp X))) = ∫ t,G t

declarations.name: basisOrder
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def basisOrder (i : actualCuspBasisIndex N hN) : ℂ :=
  if actualCuspNativeEigenvalue N hN i ≤ 1/4 then
    (Real.sqrt (1/4-actualCuspNativeEigenvalue N hN i) : ℂ)
  else (Real.sqrt (actualCuspNativeEigenvalue N hN i-1/4) : ℂ) * Complex.I

declarations.name: basisMode_eq_K
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem basisMode_eq_K (i : actualCuspBasisIndex N hN) (g : SL(2, ℤ))
    {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    basisMode N hN i g n y = basisRhoK N hN i g n * (Real.sqrt y : ℂ) *
      complexOrderK (basisOrder N hN i) (2*Real.pi*|(n : ℝ)|*y)

declarations.name: basisRhoW
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def basisRhoW (i : actualCuspBasisIndex N hN) (g : SL(2, ℤ)) (n : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  basisRhoK N hN i g n / (2 * (Real.sqrt |(n : ℝ)| : ℂ))

declarations.name: basisR
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def basisR (i : actualCuspBasisIndex N hN) (g : SL(2, ℤ)) (n : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.sqrt |(n : ℝ)| : ℂ) * basisRhoW N hN i g n

declarations.name: basisR_eq_half_native
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem basisR_eq_half_native (i : actualCuspBasisIndex N hN) (g : SL(2, ℤ))
    {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    basisR N hN i g n = basisRhoK N hN i g n / 2

declarations.name: height
declarations.source_signature_or_definition: def height (i : Idx) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (actualCuspNativeEigenvalue N (NeZero.pos N) i-1/4)

declarations.name: exceptional
declarations.source_signature_or_definition: def exceptional (i : Idx) : Prop := actualCuspNativeEigenvalue N (NeZero.pos N) i<1/4

declarations.name: order_regular
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem order_regular {i : Idx} (h : ¬exceptional N i) :
    basisOrder N (NeZero.pos N) i=((height N i:ℝ):ℂ)*I

declarations.name: fricke_measure
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
private theorem fricke_measure (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    MeasurePreserving (quotientFricke N (NeZero.pos N)) (carrierPushforward N) (carrierPushforward N)

declarations.name: pulled_infinity
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
private theorem pulled_infinity (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (n : ℤ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport φ) (hp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :
    originalPoincare N false n φ ∘ quotientFricke N (NeZero.pos N) =ᵐ[carrierPushforward N]
      zeroCuspPoincare N (NeZero.pos N) n φ hc hp

declarations.name: one_zero_pair
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem one_zero_pair (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (n : ℤ) (φ : ℝ → ℂ) (hφ : Continuous φ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport φ) (hp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ))
    (F : Gamma0OrbitSpace N → ℂ) (hF : MemLp F 2 (carrierPushforward N)) :
    (∫ q, star (originalPoincare N true n φ q)*F q ∂carrierPushforward N) =
      e ((n : ℝ)/(N : ℝ)) * ∫ q, star (zeroCuspPoincare N (NeZero.pos N) n φ hc hp q)*F q ∂carrierPushforward N

declarations.name: packet_test
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem packet_test (one neg : Bool) {L H : ℝ} (hL : 0<L) (hH : 0<H)
    (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℂ) (band : Dyadic L S) :
    let ξ := seed H
    let B := (8+32*(L*H/(N:ℝ)))*energy S a
    let F := fun t : ℝ => ‖orderProbe 1 ξ.toFun ((t:ℂ)*I)‖^2*lineMass N one neg S a t
    (∀ J : Finset Idx,(∑ i∈J,‖orderProbe 1 ξ.toFun (basisOrder N (NeZero.pos N) i)*
      discreteRow N one neg S a i‖^2) ≤ B) ∧ Integrable F ∧ (∫ t,F t)≤B

declarations.name: baseTerm
lineTerm
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def lineTerm (one neg : Bool) (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℂ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  lineMass N one neg S a t/Real.cosh (Real.pi*t)

declarations.name: base_cumulative
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem base_cumulative (one neg : Bool) {L K : ℝ} (hL : 0<L) (hK : K≤2)
    (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℂ) (band : Dyadic L S) :
    Summable (baseTerm N one neg K S a) ∧
    (∑' i,baseTerm N one neg K S a i) ≤ baseConstant*(1+L/(N:ℝ))*energy S a ∧
    IntegrableOn (lineTerm N one neg S a) (Icc (-K) K) ∧
    (∫ t in Icc (-K) K,lineTerm N one neg S a t) ≤ baseConstant*(1+L/(N:ℝ))*energy S a

declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem rank_one_term (q m n k : ℕ+) (ψ φ : HeightSeed) :
    term (induced (fun a b => ψ.toFun a*star (φ.toFun b))) q m n k=
      star (if q.val∣k.val then orbital m n k ψ φ else 0)

declarations.name: all_moduli
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
private theorem all_moduli (q m n : ℕ+) (ψ φ : HeightSeed) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ+ => if q.val∣k.val then orbital m n k ψ φ else 0) (offDiagonal q m n ψ φ)

declarations.name: full_rank_one_trace
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem full_rank_one_trace (q m n : ℕ+) (ψ φ : HeightSeed) :
    let P := fun a b => ψ.toFun a*star (φ.toFun b)
    Summable (term (induced P) q m n) ∧
    diagonal P 1 m.val (n.val:ℤ)+(∑' k,term (induced P) q m n k)=
        star ((∑' i,atom q m ψ i*star (atom q n φ i))+(∫ t,eisenstein q m n ψ φ t))

declarations.name: seed
declarations.source_signature_or_definition: def seed (C T : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : SmoothHeightSeed := fromLog (logSeed C T k)

declarations.name: cutoff_probe
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem cutoff_probe (m : ℤ) (hm : m≠0) (T : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (ν : ℂ) :
    orderProbe m (seed (rate m) T k).toFun ν =
      2*∫ q in Ioi (0:ℝ),(window k (Real.log q):ℂ)*density T ν q

declarations.name: cutoff_limit
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem cutoff_limit (m : ℤ) (hm : m≠0) (T : ℝ) {ν : ℂ} (hν : |ν.re|<1/2) :
    Tendsto (fun k => orderProbe m (seed (rate m) T k).toFun ν) atTop (𝓝 (2*probe T ν))

declarations.name: dyadic_gaussian_majorant
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem dyadic_gaussian_majorant :
    ∃ C : ℝ,0<C ∧ ∀ {K t : ℝ}, 2≤|t| → K/2≤|t| → |t|≤K →
      K*(Real.cosh (Real.pi*t))⁻¹ ≤ C*∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ),mass K t r

theorem gram (q : ℕ+) {M : ℕ} (hM : 0<M) (a : ℕ→ℂ) (j : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    (‖vector q M a (compact r j)‖^2:ℝ)=

        (packet M a (fun m n => series q (mark m) (mark n) (some j) r)).re

      (packet M a (fun m n => ∑' c,term (gaussianOrbit K) q (mark m) (mark n) c))

theorem positive_shell : ∃ C : ℝ,0<C ∧ ∀ {e K : ℝ},0<e → 2≤K → ∀ (q : ℕ+) {M : ℕ},0<M →
    ∀ a : ℕ→ℂ,
      (∀ J : Finset (Idx q),
        (∀ i∈J,¬exceptional q.val i ∧ height q.val i∈window K) →
        (∑ i∈J,‖D q M a i‖^2/cosh (π*height q.val i))≤
          C*((π*sqrt π/8)*K^2+cost e*((M:ℝ)^(1+e)/q.val))*dyadEnergy M a) ∧
      (∫ t,L q M a t/cosh (π*t) ∂windowMeasure K)≤

declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def spatial (q : ℕ+) (one : Bool) (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℂ) (f : ℕ→ℤ)
    (nf : ∀ n∈S,f n≠0) (ψ : HeightSeed) : QuotientL2 q.val :=
  (packet_L2 q.val one S a f nf ψ.toFun ψ.continuous ψ.compact ψ.positive).toLp
    (packet q.val one S a f ψ.toFun)

declarations.name: native
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
def native (q : ℕ+) (one : Bool) (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℂ) (f : ℕ→ℤ) (t : ℝ) :=
  nativeMass q.val (fun b => markedRow S a f (fun n => nativeR b one n t))

declarations.name: spectral_squares
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem spectral_squares (q : ℕ+) (one : Bool) (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℂ) (f : ℕ→ℤ)
    (nf : ∀ n∈S,f n≠0) (ψ : HeightSeed) :
    let B := ‖spatial q one S a f nf ψ‖^2
    let D := fun i => markedRow S a f (basisR q.val q.property i (originalFrame one))
    let C := fun t : ℝ => ‖orderProbe 1 ψ.toFun ((t:ℂ)*I)‖^2*native q one S a f t
    (∀ J : Finset (actualCuspBasisIndex q.val q.property),
      (∑ i∈J,‖orderProbe 1 ψ.toFun (basisOrder q.val q.property i)*D i‖^2)≤B) ∧
      Integrable C ∧ (∫ t,C t)≤B

declarations.name: positive_vector
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem positive_vector (q : ℕ+) {M : ℕ} (hM : 0<M) (a : ℕ→ℂ) (ψ : HeightSeed) :
    spatial q false (block M) (row M a) (index M) (nonzero hM) ψ=vector q M a ψ

def mass (q : ℕ+) (M : ℕ) (a : ℕ→ℂ) (K : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :=
  weight K r*‖vector q M a (compact r j)‖^2

declarations.name: energy_limit
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem energy_limit {K : ℝ} (hp : 0<K) (q : ℕ+) {M : ℕ} (hM : 0<M) (a : ℕ→ℂ) :
    (∀ j,Integrable (mass q M a K j)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => ∫ r : ℝ,mass q M a K j r) atTop (𝓝 (limitEnergy q M a K))

declarations.name: energy_bound
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem energy_bound {e K : ℝ} (he : 0<e) (hK : 2≤K) (q : ℕ+) {M : ℕ} (hM : 0<M) (a : ℕ→ℂ) :
    limitEnergy q M a K≤
      ((π*sqrt π/8)*K^3+cost e*K*((M:ℝ)^(1+e)/q.val))*dyadEnergy M a

declarations.name: integral_window
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem integral_window {K : ℝ} (hK : 0<K) {L : ℝ→ℝ} (cont : Continuous L) (L0 : ∀ t,0≤L t) :
    (∀ j,Integrable (lineDensity K j L) (volume.prod (windowMeasure K))) ∧
    Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => ∫ z,lineDensity K (some j) L z ∂volume.prod (windowMeasure K))
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ z,lineDensity K none L z ∂volume.prod (windowMeasure K)))

declarations.name: discrete_integral
declarations.source_signature_or_definition:
theorem discrete_integral {K : ℝ} (hK : 0<K) (t : ℝ) :
    (∀ j,Integrable (discreteDensity K j t)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => ∫ r : ℝ,discreteDensity K (some j) t r) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ r : ℝ,discreteDensity K none t r))

declarations.name: shell_floor

    K/cosh (π*t)≤C*∫ r : ℝ,discreteDensity K none t r
